summary: Klaviyo was named a Visionary in the inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Email Marketing Platforms.

Klaviyo’s approach to data-driven email


Generated by Klaviyo AI


Klaviyo was named a Visionary in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Email Marketing Platforms. The post outlines its approach to AI-assisted audits, large-scale sending, and real-time customer data, with examples of how Dagne Dover and DKNY adjusted their email programs.


-


**Gartner placement:** Gartner evaluated 12 vendors on Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute, naming Klaviyo a Visionary.


-


**AI-assisted audits:** Composer reviews live flows and campaigns, prioritizes fixes by revenue impact, and requires approval before changes go live.


-


**Large-scale sending:** Klaviyo can send 100 million emails in 15 minutes, with regional send-time optimization and translation into 60 languages within one campaign.


-


**Shared customer data:** Klaviyo Data Platform maintains real-time profile and event data through more than 400 native integrations, two-way warehouse sync, and an MCP server.


-


**Targeted email results:** After reducing volume and refining segmentation, DKNY reported 24% lower email volume and an 8% higher click rate year over year during the case study’s three-month period.

---


Klaviyo was named a Visionary in the inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Email Marketing Platforms. Gartner evaluated 12 vendors on two measures, Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute.


We believe email works best when a brand remembers what its customers love. A brand does that with one real-time customer profile behind each message, and AI that handles the repetitive work so your team can focus on the relationship. We also believe the placement reflects a bet we’ve been making for a while: that email gets better when AI agents handle the audits, when the tools a brand uses can work from the same customer data, and when sending keeps up with your biggest moments.


## Let AI agents handle the audits


[Composer](https://www.klaviyo.com/composer) , Klaviyo’s AI marketing agent, reads your live flows and campaigns, flags what’s missing or decaying, and ranks the fixes by revenue impact. You can also ask it questions about your data in plain language, and it writes and runs the Structured Query Language (SQL) for you. Nothing goes live without your approval.


[Dagne Dover](https://www.dagnedover.com/) manages 1.2 million active profiles and more than 30 live flows without a dedicated analyst. An audit of its automations, run through Klaviyo’s Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and Claude, found that the second email in its abandoned cart flow was getting the most opens. Customers who had recently engaged with a campaign weren’t receiving the first email, because of a Smart Sending set-up the team had configured by accident. The team estimates it would have taken days to diagnose alone. In the week after the fix,[revenue from the flow rose 44% week over week](https://www.klaviyo.com/customers/case-studies/dagne-dover-ai) .


## Send to millions in minutes


Klaviyo can send 100 million emails in 15 minutes, with regional send-time optimization and translation into 60 languages in a single campaign. During Black Friday Cyber Monday 2025, Klaviyo delivered more than 22.7 billion messages, up 25% year over year, and nearly 20,000 customers recorded their best sales day ever, according to[Klaviyo’s BFCM 2025 results announcement](https://www.klaviyo.com/newsroom/bfcm-holiday-shopping) .


## Put one customer profile behind each email


AI agents are only as useful as the data behind them.[Klaviyo Data Platform](https://www.klaviyo.com/solutions/customer-data-platform) keeps profile and event data in real time, with 400+ native integrations, two-way sync with your data warehouse, and an MCP server that lets tools like Claude and ChatGPT work from the same data. It processes more than 4.2 billion signals a day across more than 9 billion profiles.


[DKNY](https://www.dkny.com/) shows what that looks like in email. Its list of more than 1.2 million active subscribers wasn’t engaging at the rate its size suggested, and Griffin Hawkinson, director of CRM and loyalty at AM Retail Group, which manages lifecycle marketing for DKNY and 4 other fashion brands, saw that frequent, general campaigns had oversaturated it. His team cut volume and used customer data to segment by average order value, send different welcome messages to in-store and online sign-ups, and show each customer the product they’re most likely to buy next.


In the 3 months covered by the case study’s September 2026 update, DKNY’s[email volume fell 24% and its click rate rose 8%, both year over year](https://www.klaviyo.com/customers/case-studies/dkny) . In that same period, 30% of its Klaviyo-attributed value, the revenue from orders placed within a set window after a message is sent, came from flows.
“The goal with less sending is that when we have a sale 3 months from now, that message stands out in someone’s inbox,” Hawkinson says.


## What comes next


Being named a Visionary in the inaugural Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Email Marketing Platforms is a milestone for us. We were also named a[Challenger in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Multichannel Marketing Hubs](https://www.klaviyo.com/blog/gartner-magic-quadrant-multichannel-marketing-hubs) , and we believe the two placements point the same way, toward a B2C CRM that works today and AI agents built for what email needs next.


Recently, we brought Composer to iOS and Android, so you can[approve a campaign from your phone](https://www.klaviyo.com/blog/composer-mobile-customer-agent-channel-affinity) .


We’ll keep building AI agents that work under your team’s guardrails, on one customer profile, so each email reads like it came from a brand that knows the customer.
